The SVG path uses two arc commands with the same large radius (18.81) and same sweep flag 1, drawing from (57.33,25.85) to (20.15,31.57) and back again, forming a closed shape.  
The identical radii and the fact that the start/end points are symmetric with respect to the center indicate this is an ellipse — not a circle because the rotation parameter 351.25° means the ellipse is rotated, and the arc flags and coordinates match an elliptical arc, not a polygon or sector.  

Final answer: (K)
